title: Reuben Sandwich
description: Reuben Sandwich is a dish from United States prepared with rye bread, corned beef, sauerkraut, swiss cheese. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Mayonnaise replaces the more complex Russian dressing; add a little ketchup or relish to approximate it.

steps.instruction: Toast these ingredients over medium heat for about 6 minutes, turning frequently to prevent scorching.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
Pan-fry the prepared food from the previous stages on both sides until browned and fully cooked.
